acmecorp-beth (customer): Hey team — we're seeing 0 tokens in the Console when filtering Region=eu and ModelVersion=v2.1 for the past 24h. API logs show requests succeeded. Can you check?

jess (support): Sorry about that, Beth. Ticket #SUP-4821 opened. Can you paste an example request id? :eyes:

acmecorp-beth (customer): request_id=01H8X9ZQK2R5YQ0A1B23, timestamp=2026-03-16T11:12:03Z. Console screenshot attached (shows empty chart).

jess (support): Reproducing locally now. Quick check: API ingestion timestamp and metrics pipeline both show events for that request id. So data exists upstream.

rachel (analytics): I pulled the raw event for that request_id. payload excerpt: ```json
{
  "request_id":"01H8X9ZQK2R5YQ0A1B23",
  "region":"eu-west-1",
  "model":"redwood/gpt-large",
  "version":"v2.1",
  "sample_rate":1,
  "tokens":242
}```

rachel (analytics): The Console filtering query expects region values as the short code `eu` (legacy field) but our ingest pipeline started emitting full zone ids like `eu-west-1` after the routing change last quarter. Looks like a normalization mismatch.

tom (eng-frontend): Oof. The frontend build assumes normalized_region derived from `region_short` tag. If none, it falls back to filtering by `region` exact match. That falls through when users select `eu` in the UI.

mike (sre): Confirmed in metrics index: two separate keys exist — `region_short: eu` and `region_raw: eu-west-1`. The console filter resolver is only checking `region_short` for multi-selects. A multi-select of multiple regions triggers a search scoped to `region_short` only which returns empty for new events.

jess (support): Customer-facing impact: when version filter is applied plus region=eu it shows nothing, but removing version shows EU traffic aggregated (because other code path uses `region_raw`). Noted.

acmecorp-beth (customer): Any ETA on workaround? Our dashboards depend on region+version split. :sad-panda:

rachel (analytics): Temporary workaround: in Console -> Advanced filters, set Region to `eu-west-1` (the zone id) instead of `eu`. That will show the data. Patch: we can update alias mapping in the UI to expose zone ids until fix.

tom (eng-frontend): I'll patch the UI to show both `eu` and `eu-west-1` in the dropdown labels (non-breaking) and enable a fallback query that ORs `region_short:eu` OR `region_raw:eu-west-1`. Quick patch + deploy to staging in ~2h. :shipit:

mike (sre): Backend plan: reconcile downstream services. We need a one-time backfill to populate `region_short` for recent events and a small normalization hotfix in the ingestion router. I'll open infra change CHG-992 and schedule a low-risk backfill for tonight.

jess (support): For support notes: advise Acme to use `eu-west-1` for now and that we're working on a fix and backfill. Also confirm no tokens lost.

acmecorp-beth (customer): Thanks — confirming `eu-west-1` shows the charts now. Please ping when it's fixed.

rachel (analytics): Root cause summary for the ticket: region normalization header removed in router after routing refactor -> mixed `region` formats in index -> console filter resolver only checked `region_short` when version filter present -> results omitted. Impact window: 2026-02-12 to present for newly emitted events in eu zones.

tom (eng-frontend): Deploying UI fallback to staging. Code snippet for the OR query I'll push: ```json
{"bool":{"should":[{"term":{"region_short":"eu"}},{"term":{"region_raw":"eu-west-1"}}]}}```

mike (sre): Backfill job planned: reindex recent 30 days adding computed `region_short` from `region_raw` using mapping table. Running dry-run now: reindex_preview shows ~12k docs affected, expected run time ~18m. Scheduling at 02:00 UTC.

jess (support): I'll update the customer with the workaround, ETA for staged fallback (2h), and the backfill window (02:00 UTC tonight). Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

alertbot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-16-27 — Console filter normalization bug.

rachel (analytics): Follow-up: once backfill completes we'll re-run the dashboard evaluation suite to check for regressions. I'll also add a telemetry alert if `region_short` missing rate >1% for ingested events.

acmecorp-beth (customer): Appreciate the fast turnaround — leaving this thread open until backfill completes.

jess (support): Will close when backfill done and UI fallback verified in prod.
